purpose: Fixed two-resolution development comparison; no model promotion or application default change
background: Original complete unique core-owner camera view; same at-most48 native-resolution median samples before resize
temporal_ensemble: Every original native source frame in the complete target view; unchanged weighted overlapping windows and scene resets
localization: Unchanged observed components and bounded selector; no interpolation, threshold search or coordinate correction

control_gate.source_frames: Compare every native row in every complete original target view before any candidate inference or scoring
exact: component order and all component fields except confidence
control_gate.mismatch: Preserve all output and diagnostics; block candidate inference and comparable scoring; never substitute the new control for the baseline

metrics.wrong_location: One localization FP and FN; remains visibility TP
metrics.unknown: Unscored truth; retained in all coverage denominators
metrics.unavailable: Retained; known positives are misses and unavailable negatives never become true negatives
metrics.uncertainty: Frozen radial-label lower/upper error and strict localization recall bounds, not statistical confidence intervals
metrics.observed_component_recall: For available visible/localizable cases, any observed component within the same fixed nominal tolerance; distinguish component absence from selection errors
performance: peak GPU tensor allocation MB (10^6 bytes)

execution.admission: Real original shared data/processed Store through run_local_job plus committed queue GPU grant; isolated research storage never supplies admission
execution.outputs: Exclusive ignored per-view checkpoints and immutable receipts bound to complete source, clock, label, protocol, code, runtime, model and view hashes
execution.resume: Only complete matching sealed view checkpoints after verified prior PID/lifetime, Store status and artifact evidence; never assume exit from timeout
execution.preservation: No source, label, original prediction, app annotation, environment or weight changes

limitations: Familiar two-source development cases, not a held-out or human-certified benchmark
Twenty-eight unknowns and no established occlusion, camera-transition or visible-unlocalizable support remain
Higher input resolution with unchanged weights can worsen outputs, runtime or memory; report both fixed variants without tuning
A negative or incompatible result is valid; broader source-separated singles/doubles and independent full-match validation remain required
No consumed holdout63 inputs or metadata, training, downloads, model installation/promotion or complete-accuracy claim
